notes.title: Steam Deck verified!
notes.content:
Hello Footgunner, 

Have you always wanted to explore the Underground, kick some upgraded balls into your enemies, and try to defeat all the bosses - all while being on the go? 

Well, now you can do it in the best way possible! 
Footgun: Underground is officially verified for playing on the Steam Deck. 

So grab your high-tech handheld PC and enjoy some adrenaline-kicking runs while traveling, going to school/work or chilling on the couch.

notes.content: - Reworked text sizes for better readability on Steam Deck

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1.1
notes.content:
- Added Steam Controller text input support.
- Introduced a new character, Mr. Titan Tanner, for the "Not Even Close" achievement.
- All characters now start with a double jump.
- Fixed shop train overlapping with other interactions.
- Soccer special characters are now variants of the main character in the selection menu.

notes.title: Let's kick it to the PixElated Adventures event!
notes.content:
Greetings Footgunners,
Are you also a fan of great pixel games like us? (Probably yes, since you're reading this post 😁)  
We're happy to announce that Footgun: Underground is part of the awesome PixElated Adventures event, running from 29 July to 5 August. 

The event consists of: 

 a Steam Event page with lots of discounts
 a Reddit AMA with developers 
 an art contest to showcase your creations on the event page for millions to see

So in a week, if you want to fill your cart with a selection of great pixel games or recommend Footgun to a friend, check out the Steam event page or visit the website for more information: http://www.pixelatedfest.com/  

Many thanks to BraveAtNight for organizing this event and to you for keeping the ball rolling in Footgun: Underground!

notes.title: Kick-Off Update + Games Baked in Germany Event!
notes.content:
Greetings Footgunners,

The European Championship has started and if you're as captivated as we are, you'll surely enjoy our latest "Kick-Off" update for Footgun: Underground!

We're releasing 6 new characters for even more football action! If you want to further improve your skills and smash enemies with your football-gun skills, this is for you!

And if the timing wasn't perfect enough, we are participating in the Games Baked in Germany Event with a juicy discount - ideal if you want your friends to try out the game! 

Come take a look at the free update and lead your team to victory (or at least out of the Underground)!

notes.title: Gamescom latam 2024 - let's kick some balls in Brazil!
notes.content:
Greetings Footgunner, 

As we continue to improve the game so you can have a kick-ass time with it, we have some fantastic news to announce! 

Footgun: Underground is nominated for the gamescom latam awards in the category "Innovation"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166161/f7a6c18e6a40e03018a40c05fb9f0f2bb7cc3a29.gif

(Fire the laser- ehh fireworks)


The entire team is excited and honored to be recognized by such an important event. 
If you plan on attending the event in Brazil, you can check out our game station and show off your mad ball skills to the visitors. 

Well, that's it - short and sweet! 
We'll let you know if we take home the trophy and until then - congratulations to all the other nominees and thank you for joining us on our ballsy journey with Footgun! 

P.S.: We'll soon have some exciting game-related news to share, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Footgun: Underground – Upcoming Trailer and new Screenshots
notes.content:
Greetings Footgunner,

Do you want to see some more fricking-kicking roguelike action?! Well, you don’t need to wait until release as our new trailer is almost ready! 

Until then, here are some screenshots and GIFs, showcasing never-before-seen bosses, balls, and two biotopes – Science and Overgrown.

Do you think you can survive in this place, where nature has reclaimed its rightful place?
